errors.evidence: The list of model names on the horizontal axis is incomplete and contains multiple errors. For example, it lists 'Llama 2 Scout' instead of 'Llama 4 Scout', 'Llama 40' instead of 'GPT-4o', and 'Gemini 2.0 (No Code)' instead of 'Gemini 2.0 Flash (No Code)'. It also omits several models present in the chart, such as 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code)' and 'o4-mini (No Code)'.

errors.text_span: Four sets of bars are displayed for each model
errors.evidence: The chart displays five sets of bars for each model, corresponding to the five categories listed in the legend. The description incorrectly states there are four.
The description omits one of the five categories shown in the legend and the chart: 'Equivalence-All-Hard'.
There is no 'teal' color in the chart; all bars are shades of blue.

errors.text_span: while the ‘Equivalence-One-Hard’ bar has a height around 16%.
errors.evidence: For the ‘Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code)’ model, the ‘Equivalence-One-Hard’ bar (the third bar in the group) has a height of approximately 83%, not 16%.
For the ‘GPT-4o mini’ model, the ‘Seed’ bar (the darkest blue bar) has a height of approximately 55%, not 8%.
For the 'GPT-4o mini' model, the 'Equivalence-One-Hard' bar (the third bar in the group) has a value of approximately 5%, not 2%.

errors.text_span: and the ‘Equivalence-One-Hard’ bars are the shortest.
errors.evidence: Across most models, the shortest bars correspond to the 'Equivalence-All-Hard' category (the fifth bar in each group), not the 'Equivalence-One-Hard' category (the third bar).
The models on the horizontal axis are not ordered alphabetically. For example, 'Gemma 3 27B' comes after 'DeepSeek-V3' but before 'Llama 4 Scout', which breaks alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: a group of four adjacent bars
errors.evidence: The chart shows groups of five bars for each model, not four. The legend also clearly lists five distinct categories.

errors.text_span: colored blue, light blue, medium blue, and dark blue, representing “Seed,” “Equivalence-One-Easy,” “Equivalence-One-Hard,” and “Equivalence-All-Hard” data respectively
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors to categories and misses one category. The figure shows five categories. According to the legend, the darkest blue represents 'Seed', not 'Equivalence-All-Hard'. The description is both incomplete (missing 'Equivalence-All-Easy') and factually wrong in its mapping.
The description completely omits the fifth category shown in the legend, which is 'Equivalence-All-Easy'.

errors.text_span: a medium blue “Equivalence-One-Hard” bar reaching approximately 50%, and a dark blue “Equivalence-All-Hard” bar reaching approximately 18%
errors.evidence: The reported values for the 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code)' group are grossly inaccurate. The 'Equivalence-One-Hard' bar is at approximately 83%, not 50%. The 'Equivalence-All-Hard' bar is at approximately 66%, not 18%.

errors.text_span: with values ranging from near zero to approximately 25% depending on the model
errors.evidence: The description states that the values for 'Equivalence-All-Hard' bars range up to 25%. However, the bar for 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code)' in this category reaches approximately 66%, which is far outside the stated range.
